meta.title: Worktree Space
meta.description: Worktree Space: one task, one space — work on parallel tracks. Put a task that spans one or more Git repositories into its own task space: every repository involved gets a worktree on the same task branch, and the task space registers itself as a workspace where agent sessions work on their own. Multiple tasks move forward in parallel without interfering with one another; when the work is done, merge back into each repository's target branch and clean up the worktree branches and task spaces as needed. Report problems at https://github.com/kangtsang/dsh-worktree-space/issues
